hook_title.fr: Il cache sa mère à son propre mariage

loop_note: Partie 1, coupée sur l'aveu d'Api, avant la réaction de Monsieur Ananas.

fr.title: Partie 1 : ELLE A SERVI AU MARIAGE DE SON FILS 💔
fr.description: Mamie Pomme a vendu son verger pour payer les études de son fils. Le jour de son mariage, il lui demande de venir… en servante. Mais le père de la mariée la reconnaît. Qu'aurais-tu fait à la place d'Api ? Voix et images générées par IA.

cast.name: Mamie Pomme
cast.look: a poor 70-year-old seamstress whose whole head is a wrinkled red-brown baked apple with a short stem, kind tired eyes behind round glasses, a flowered headscarf, a worn beige cardigan over a simple grey dress, rough working hands, small and stooped
cast.voice: a warm fragile elderly female voice, tender and slow

cast.name: Api
cast.look: a 30-year-old lawyer whose whole head is a perfect shiny polished red apple with a small green leaf, arrogant eyebrows, a tailored navy suit, a white shirt, a gold watch, slim and upright
cast.voice: a confident young male voice that turns cold and contemptuous

cast.name: Monsieur Ananas
cast.look: the richest man in town, about 60, whose whole head is a golden pineapple with a proud spiky leafy crown, deep kind eyes, a white tuxedo with a black bow tie, broad shoulders
cast.voice: a deep powerful male voice in his sixties, moved then furious

cast.name: Framboise
cast.look: a young bride whose whole head is a plump bright raspberry, gentle eyes, a white lace wedding dress and a short veil, holding a bouquet of white roses
cast.voice: a soft warm young female voice

cast.name: Madame Citron
cast.look: a snobbish wedding guest whose whole head is a shiny yellow lemon, haughty half-closed eyes, an emerald green evening gown, a diamond necklace, holding a champagne glass

lines.text: Mon fils se marie demain… et il me veut en servante.

scenes.visual_prompt: Mamie Pomme, heartbroken, stands in front of a cracked mirror in her tiny sewing workshop at night, holding a maid's white apron, one bare light bulb. Medium close-up, cold light and warm bulb glow
scenes.motion_prompt: She slowly lifts the apron against her chest and looks at her reflection, a tear falls. Quiet room, a sewing machine clock ticking.

lines.text: J'ai vendu mon verger pour payer ses études.

scenes.visual_prompt: Mamie Pomme, younger and proud, plants a wooden SOLD sign in a sunny apple orchard, a little apple-headed boy with a school bag holds her skirt. Sepia flashback, wide shot, golden light
scenes.motion_prompt: The wind moves the apple trees, she caresses the boy's head, slow pan. Birds singing.

lines.text: Maman, personne ne doit savoir que tu es ma mère.

scenes.visual_prompt: Api, cold and impatient, on the phone in a sleek glass office with a city view, gold watch visible. Medium shot, bright daylight
scenes.motion_prompt: Api paces with the phone to his ear and checks his watch. Office noise, a keyboard.

lines.text: Mais… je suis ta mère, Api.

scenes.visual_prompt: Mamie Pomme, lips trembling, holds an old phone to her ear in her dark workshop. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: Her lips tremble, she closes her eyes. Silence.

lines.text: Sa famille est la plus riche. Tu sers, et tu te tais.

scenes.visual_prompt: Api, contemptuous, ends the call in his glass office and straightens his tie. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: He hangs up and adjusts his tie without looking back. Office noise.

scenes.visual_prompt: Mamie Pomme, stooped, wearing the white maid apron, carries a silver tray of champagne glasses through an elegant castle garden wedding, flower arch, fruit-headed guests in evening clothes laughing. Wide shot, golden hour
scenes.motion_prompt: She walks slowly between the guests with the heavy tray, nobody looks at her. Soft string quartet music and laughter.

lines.text: Attention, la vieille ! Tu sais combien coûte ma robe ?

scenes.visual_prompt: Madame Citron, disgusted, bumps into Mamie Pomme and champagne splashes on the white apron, at the castle garden wedding. Medium shot
scenes.motion_prompt: Champagne spills, Madame Citron steps back shouting and shaking her hand. Guests murmur.

lines.text: Va nettoyer ça. Et ne me refais jamais honte.

scenes.visual_prompt: Api, ashamed and furious, leans toward Mamie Pomme and whispers in her ear, at the wedding garden, guests blurred behind. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: Api grips her arm and whispers, looking around nervously. Garden murmur.

scenes.visual_prompt: Mamie Pomme, humiliated, on her knees wiping the marble floor with a cloth, a tear falls on the tiles. Close-up from low angle
scenes.motion_prompt: A tear drops onto the marble in slow motion, she keeps wiping. Soft piano.

scenes.visual_prompt: Monsieur Ananas, majestic, arrives at the castle garden wedding in a white tuxedo, guests stepping aside respectfully. Wide shot, golden hour
scenes.motion_prompt: He walks forward slowly as the guests part, camera tracking backward. Crowd murmur: 'Monsieur Ananas!'

scenes.visual_prompt: Monsieur Ananas, frozen with shock, sees Mamie Pomme on her knees; his champagne glass slips from his hand. Medium shot
scenes.motion_prompt: The glass falls and shatters on the marble in slow motion, he stares. Sound of breaking glass, then silence.

lines.text: C'est vous… la couturière de la rue des Lilas ?

scenes.visual_prompt: Monsieur Ananas, moved to tears, kneels in front of Mamie Pomme and takes her rough hands in his. Close-up two-shot
scenes.motion_prompt: He gently holds her hands, his eyes fill with tears, slow push-in. Silence, soft piano.

lines.text: Quand je dormais dehors, vous m'avez nourri tout un hiver.

scenes.visual_prompt: A skinny barefoot little pineapple-headed boy shivering in the snow at night; a young Mamie Pomme gives him a bowl of hot soup and a hand-sewn coat in front of her little workshop. Sepia flashback, warm window light
scenes.motion_prompt: Steam rises from the soup, snow falls, she wraps the coat around him. Soft wind.

lines.text: Qui a mis un tablier à celle qui m'a sauvé ?

scenes.visual_prompt: Monsieur Ananas, furious, stands up and faces the frozen wedding guests, his crown leaves trembling. Low angle, golden hour
scenes.motion_prompt: He turns slowly to the crowd, jaw clenched. Total silence.

scenes.visual_prompt: Api, livid and sweating in his navy suit, next to Framboise in her wedding dress who stares at him in shock. Close-up
scenes.motion_prompt: Api swallows hard, sweat runs down his apple skin, Framboise slowly turns toward him. A heartbeat.

scenes.visual_prompt: Api, ashamed, looks at his mother Mamie Pomme still on her knees in her white apron. Extreme close-up on Api
scenes.motion_prompt: His lips tremble, he lowers his eyes, slow push-in. Silence.
